create_custom_allreduce: create a CustomAllreduce instance to perform optimized all-reduce operations across GPUs in a process group
run_custom_all_reduce: run a custom all-reduce operation on a tensor to reduce communication overhead between GPUs
test_should_custom_ar: test whether a tensor should use custom all-reduce based on size, contiguity, and hardware capabilities
build_capture_context: build a CUDA graph capture context to register graph buffers for custom all-reduce operations
dispatch_custom_allreduce: dispatch the appropriate custom all-reduce class based on hardware type and environment configuration
